description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers DE+EN phrasings for reviewing a migration/schema diff for scale hazards. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours: authoring a migration (laravel-migration), live-traffic performance (performance-analysis), audit-tier selection (history-design), generic code review.
